title: Riot Squad Punx Mango, Peach & Pineapple Nic salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: This refreshingly fruity vape from Riot Squad’s Punx line features a ripe, dominant mango blended with luscious peach and a deliciously tangy edge from pineapple. Riot Squad’s Punx Nicotine Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, an innovative blend of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine and 50/50 PG and VG ratio provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit and makes this eliquid ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices.
